conversation.Statement: Good afternoon, this is Officer Daniel Wright from the Internal Revenue Service, badge number 485273. Am I speaking with Mrs. Helen Parker?
Yes, this is Helen. What is this about?

Mrs. Parker, we're contacting you regarding discrepancies in your business tax filings for 2022 and 2023, specifically related to unpaid 1099-MISC forms for contract labor. Did you receive any notice from the IRS?
No, I haven't gotten anything from the IRS. I always pay what I owe.
Our records show you failed to declare certain income, and the IRS has opened a case file against your business. Case number IR-2590. This may escalate if not resolved.
Oh my, I didn't realize. What does that mean for me?
If not addressed, you could be facing a fine of up to $7,500, an immediate audit, and possible suspension of your business license. You may also lose eligibility for certain government benefits.
I can't afford that! I'm retired and on Social Security. Are you sure this is right?
Mrs. Parker, I understand your concern. To avoid further penalties, the IRS allows a one-time settlement for cases like yours. Would you like to resolve this matter today to prevent escalation?
Yes, please. I don't want any trouble. What do I need to do?
Due to the urgency, the IRS requires immediate payment using government-approved digital methods. Do you have access to a smartphone or computer right now?
I have a smartphone, but I'm not very good with it. Can't I just pay by check?

Unfortunately, for cases under investigation, traditional payment methods are temporarily restricted. I will guide you through the approved process. Are you able to visit a nearby CVS or Walgreens pharmacy?
I suppose I could, but why would the IRS want me to go there?
The IRS partners with retail locations to handle settlements securely and quickly. You will need to purchase government-certified cards to process your payment. I will provide the instructions.
Alright, I can try. What kind of cards do I need to get?
Please purchase five Apple Gift Cards of $200 each. Once you have them, stay on the line and I will instruct you on how to register the cards with your case file.
Five? That's a lot of money. Are you sure this is safe?
I assure you, this is the only way to resolve your IRS case without further penalties. Let me know when you arrive at the store so I can continue assisting you.
Alright, I'll get ready and head out now. Please don't hang up.
Of course, Mrs. Parker. I'll be right here to help you every step of the way.
